summary.result: The results indicate that both MTC and MTR increased significantly over the study period, with MTC rising by approximately 0.5°C per decade and MTR by approximately 0.3°C per decade.
summary.background: At the functional-group level, fish and cephalopods exhibited significant increasing trends, whereas crustaceans showed no statistically significant long-term changes.
summary.method: Using annual data on fisheries production and revenue from 1990 to 2025, the study applies the Mean Temperature of the Catch (MTC) and the Mean Temperature of the Revenue (MTR) to assess whether fisheries production and economic value have shifted toward warm-water species.

summary_ko.method: 1990년부터 2025년까지 어업 생산량과 수익 데이터를 활용하여, 포획 온도 평균값(MTC)과 수익 온도 평균값(MTR)을 적용하여 어업 생산량과 경제적 가치가 따뜻한 수역 종으로 이동했는지를 평가하였다.
summary_ko.result: 연구 기간 동안 MTC와 MTR 모두 유의미하게 증가하였으며, MTC는 약 0.5°C당 십년, MTR은 약 0.3°C당 십년씩 상승하였다.
